en: A multi-view vintage postcard featuring eight small colored photographs of different sights around a town. Captions under each image identify local locations such as a courthouse, a canal park, a panoramic town view, an industrial waterfall area, a lock with a boat, a large inscribed rock, a bridge and church, and a river gorge. At the bottom, the town name "TROLLHÄTTAN." is printed in large white decorative letters on a dark background.
